decisions: P06-T05 follows the blueprint's exact Community detection label; an earlier handoff typo naming signals was corrected before implementation.
Community detection is deterministic weakly connected components: edge direction is ignored, node ids and communities are sorted, and optional subsets induce their own communities.
No probabilistic clustering or NetworkX dependency was introduced.
risks: Weak components are a conservative community definition; modularity or label-propagation clustering is not implemented because the blueprint gives no further algorithmic contract.
Subset detection treats requested ids as vertices even if an id is absent from storage; absent ids remain isolated.
